name: Dolva Prime
description: Dolva Prime was a planet located in the Semagi sector of the Mid Rim. Boba Fett ambushed Edo and Rolu Strom in the Old Hallet prairie of Dolva Prime in 2 ABY in order to recover a fake Arachedron sculpture.
